total_model.summary: Model projects 49.5 total points (IND 25, DAL 25). Biggest factors: Expected points from both teams' scoring (season blend) (raises total 2.1), Combined pass defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.6), Combined rush defense EPA allowed/play (raises total 1.2). The baseline of 45.7 is the typical NFL total in the training data.
